risks.note: Listed first among the Threats in the MD&A. The Company is a small branded marketing/trading player without its own manufacturing, so it competes on brand and distribution reach in a crowded domestic market.
risks.risk: Intense competition within the pharmaceutical industry

risks.note: Explicitly flagged as a Threat in the MD&A. FY2025-26 margins improved on cost management and better resource utilisation; sustained price pressure would directly erode that gain.
risks.risk: Pricing pressure from competitive market conditions

risks.note: Flagged as a Threat; the MD&A also notes the Company must adhere to established quality standards and regulatory requirements, and that internal controls are periodically realigned to changing regulatory requirements. Newly listed on the BSE SME platform, the Company also assumes listing-regulation compliance obligations.
risks.risk: Regulatory change and increasing compliance requirements

risks.note: Named as a Threat in the MD&A. Because the Company does not manufacture and relies on contractual arrangements with third-party manufacturers, supply continuity and product quality sit with counterparties rather than with in-house operations.
risks.risk: Dependence on raw material availability and supply chain stability

risks.note: Named as a Threat. Input-cost inflation that cannot be passed through would compress the profitability improvement management attributes to cost management.
Named as a Threat in the MD&A; policy shifts (including pricing and access policy) can reset demand and realisation for the product portfolio.
risks.risk: Changes in domestic and global healthcare policies

risks.note: The MD&A ratio commentary states the trade receivables turnover ratio fell, indicating a higher receivable holding period and requiring continued focus on collection efficiency; net capital turnover also declined on higher working capital employed relative to sales growth. Part of the receivable balance is with related-party counterparties in which KMP are directors.
risks.risk: Receivables / collection risk from a lengthening credit cycle

risks.note: The Company states it operates in one business segment, pharmaceutical products and related activities, sold through a distributor network; there is no segment, geography or customer diversification disclosed to absorb a shock in that one market, and 'expansion into new geographical markets' is still listed as an opportunity rather than an established base.
